title: A view's WHERE is the only boundary an anonymous role faces, and it is not a security barrier

expect.note: corpus_anon reaches `documents` only through the view, so the view's `visibility = 'public'` is a security boundary — and without `security_barrier` a caller-supplied leaky qual is evaluated against the private rows too
the same view also executes as its owner, which is what puts corpus_anon in reach of the table at all

fix: Recreate c_leaky_filter_view.public_documents WITH (security_barrier = true) so the planner cannot evaluate a caller's qual below the view's own. Where the filter is per-caller rather than a constant, an RLS policy on `documents` is stronger still: policy quals already get barrier treatment. Do not revoke corpus_anon's SELECT on the view.
